title: A card back from one deputy does not go to another (spec d2679763, A6): after «did not reach» the session leaves it for the owner; after the core refuses a second deputy it does not reach that person around the refusal (Teams, the liaison, the hub)
note: Invented names (Ann Lee — mailings, Bo Chan — backend, letters-dev). 23.11 a mailing launch came back from the deputy for mailings when the owner widened their area, and the session sent it on to the deputy for the backend. The refusal is new core words: run --only after. Turn gone-back is the case as it happened: before — GONE («do not send it again»), after — GONE_ANEW for a deputy named anew (send it to them again if it is in their area now, never to another); back_to_ann is expected to pass only after; turn refused — the session's step after the refusal. Control: a card no deputy had still goes to the deputy of its area (or the session decides the reversible itself, as ASK_AWAY allows). Turn refused is new words (empty before): read it after only.
